metadata.case_name: CHAN WAI MAN v. LUK SHUET KING T/A HING FAT PLASTIC AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: student (attending school; working at factory outside school hours)

injuries.description: Amputation of the right index finger through the proximal interphalangeal joint / revision amputation of the right index finger
source: The plaintiff sustained a crush injury on each of the four fingers of his right hand.
revision amputation of the right index, middle and ring fingers
X-Rays shows - Amputation of index and ring fingers through proximal inter-phalangeal joint and middle finger through metacarpal phalangeal joint.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic amputation of two or more fingers alone

injuries.description: Amputation of the right middle finger through the metacarpal phalangeal joint / revision amputation of the right middle finger
source: The plaintiff sustained a crush injury on each of the four fingers of his right hand.
revision amputation of the right index, middle and ring fingers
X-Rays shows - Amputation of index and ring fingers through proximal inter-phalangeal joint and middle finger through metacarpal phalangeal joint.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic amputation of two or more fingers alone

injuries.description: Amputation of the right ring finger just proximal to the proximal interphalangeal joint / revision amputation of the right ring finger
source: The plaintiff sustained a crush injury on each of the four fingers of his right hand.
revision amputation of the right index, middle and ring fingers
X-Rays shows - Amputation of index and ring fingers through proximal inter-phalangeal joint and middle finger through metacarpal phalangeal joint.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of two or more fingers at or near base, right hand

manifestations.description: Partial loss of function of right hand which prevents him from obtaining manual employment.
Embarrassment because of his deformed hand; people comment and at times tease him which causes him concern; keeps his hand clenched much of the time to mask the deformity.
Tenderness in the scar on the remaining part of his index and the stump of the middle finger; a mobile tender nodule of loose bone which is very tender to touch at the middle finger stump.
Obvious cosmetic deformity of the right hand.
From the functional aspect he has lost the use of much of his index and ring finger and the whole of his middle finger, and has a tender amputation stump on his middle finger.
His disability is permanent and will not alter significantly with time.

treatments_received: revision amputation of the right index, middle and ring fingers under general anaesthesia (same day as admission)
admitted to Queen Elizabeth Hospital immediately (7 days)
transferred to Kowloon Hospital as an in-patient for 12 days and as an out-patient for the remaining period (about three months)
treatments_future: Surgery could reduce the tenderness in the amputation stump of his middle finger (cost of surgery and after care estimated at $2,500) (mentioned as possible)

losses.description: Partial loss of function of right hand; loss of use of much of index and ring fingers and entire middle finger; prevents him obtaining manual employment; permanent functional disability.
Obvious cosmetic deformity of the right hand causing embarrassment and teasing; keeps hand clenched to mask deformity.
Handicap in meeting competition in the labour market; intended career as a metal-ware worker affected; economic loss from reduced prospects and lower pay as an apprentice.

comparable_cases.injury_description: Crushing injuries to right hand with all four fingers amputated at mid-palm level (right-handed man)
